stories.title: Ronaldinho makes debut for Italian side Ravenna after 11-year hiatus in playing career
summary: Brazil legend plays first half for Serie C club at age 46‘Is this my last one?

The 46-year-old Brazil great announced in June that he had signed for the Serie C side Ravenna, 11 years after he appeared to have brought his illustrious career to a close with Fluminense.Five months later, he was in the starting lineup as Ravenna faced their local rivals Forlì.
Ronaldinho, wearing the No 10 shirt, entered the stadium to great fanfare, with the 5,000-capacity Stadio Bruno Benelli adding a temporary 1,800-capacity stand – dubbed “R10” – for the occasion.

stories.title: Mary Earps frustrates Arsenal as London City Lionesses earn battling draw
summary: Arsenal’s fifth draw from five home games in the Women’s Super League left them frustrated once again but this was a wholly different story to the previous four, as they played out an entertaining 1-1 draw with a London City Lionesses side inspired by their goalkeeper Mary Earps.Aston Villa, Birmingham, Manchester United and Crystal Palace all came to this stadium for a point, defending resolutely and exposing Arsenal’s inability to break down low blocks, whereas London City came to play and were rewarded with a draw that maintains their six‑point advantage over Arsenal in the race for a European place, and moving within six points of the leaders Chelsea.

stories.title: Record-breaking Andy Robertson is Scotland’s finest captain
summary: As he passes Kenny Dalglish’s appearance total, it is important to remember that it is the left-back’s journey that sets him apart Andy Robertson may not be Scotland’s greatest player, but he is indisputably their finest captain.

It counts as sacrilege, even to generations who have watched Kenny Dalglish only on YouTube, to reputationally place Robertson above the Liverpool hero on the basis of a cap haul that will reach 103 in St Gallen on Monday.
Dalglish and Robertson are men in different positions in essentially a different sport.
